item_short_desc: Rothco’s Police Whistle is a reliable and durable tool designed to grab attention quickly and effectively in various situations. Made from high-quality metal, this whistle produces a loud, clear sound that ensures you're heard when it matters most. Each whistle includes a soft, braided 30-inch lanyard, allowing for convenient hands-free use. The rubber pea inside enhances the sound quality, making it perfect for law enforcement, public safety, coaches, and emergency responders.
